tasks.label: Démarrer le site (dev)
args: const { spawnSync } = require("node:child_process"); const { dbCredentials } = require("./drizzle.config.json"); const result = spawnSync("npm", ["run", "dev"], { env: { ...process.env, DATABASE_URL: dbCredentials.url }, stdio: "inherit" }); process.exit(result.status ?? 1);
